summary: Candidate is a non-empty delta (1 file, 6 insertions / 1 deletion, hasDelta=true, verificationOnly=false) repairing the audited blocker of the trusted finalizer failure (Actions run 35521604346, step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path'). The concrete blocker is the golden-path wait window after tapping Demarrer: the previous baseline waited for the 'Appartement' group with a 60s timeout, but on a cold API 35 x86_64 emulator the demo sign-in plus SQLite fixture seeding takes 30-60s and the first uiautomator dump adds another 30-60s, so a 60s window only fits one dump attempt and can expire before the groups list renders. Repair: scripts/e2e-android.js changes waitFor('Appartement', 60000) to waitFor('Appartement', 120000) with a 5-line comment documenting the timing model; 120s gives 2-3 dump attempts and matches the script's established 120s pattern used for every other post-launch element (Ajouter, Balances, A faire, etc.). No product code, domain logic, analytics, persistence, sync or governance touched; no new adb calls; no network or history-proportional work. Trusted verification exit 0: typecheck PASS, 448 tests/22 suites PASS, privacy 71 PASS, cost 21 PASS (10 gates incl. V3-08 Gate 9 golden path at domain level), expo export/prebuild PASS, :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL (20m7s). Independent re-verification: npx tsc --noEmit exit 0; npx jest 22 suites/448 tests PASS; node --check scripts/e2e-android.js SYNTAX OK; diff vs accepted-pristine shows exactly the one candidate file (plus .expo/android build dirs and the untracked TRUSTED report, all non-candidate); staged diff byte-identical to the candidate patch. The only openFindings entry in docs/RELEASE_STATUS.json is the active reopen finding for run 35521604346 (mustFix: true) that this cycle repairs; no separate unresolved mustFix remains. Informational: the trusted verification does not run the emulator E2E (finalizer's job); empirical step-7 confirmation is pending the next trusted finalizer run.

findings.problem: The golden-path wait for the 'Appartement' group after tapping Demarrer used a 60s timeout. On a cold API 35 x86_64 emulator, demo sign-in plus SQLite fixture seeding takes 30-60s and the first uiautomator dump adds another 30-60s, so a 60s window only fits one dump attempt and can expire before the groups list renders — the concrete step-7 timing blocker of run 35521604346.
findings.evidence: Baseline line: 'waitFor("Appartement", 60000);'. Candidate now: 'waitFor("Appartement", 120000);' preceded by a 5-line comment documenting the timing model (sign-in + fixture seeding 30-60s, first dump 30-60s, 60s fits one dump attempt, 120s gives 2-3). The 120s value matches the script's established pattern for every other post-launch element (waitFor('Ajouter', 120000), waitFor('Balances', 120000), waitFor('A faire', 120000)) and the documented '120s: single dump takes 30-60s on slow emulators' comment.
